We use this fact: a continuous function on a closed bounded rectangle is uniformly continuous. This means that one allowed input distance works at every point of the rectangle for a prescribed output error. The fact is supplied here; gives an optional proof.

The rectangle case was proved above by constructing a potential directly. We state the full simply connected theorem here for use. Its optional fuller proof accompanies in . That proof constructs potentials on balls and then uses a subdivided continuous contraction to show that every closed curve has zero integral. Green's theorem and Stokes' theorem give related geometric interpretations; merely saying that a loop shrinks is not yet the proof in space.
